title: Find the bug in a find_max function

metadata.notes: Bug: initializing best = 0 means nothing beats it when every number is negative, so 0 is returned instead of the true (negative) maximum. Fix should initialize best = nums[0] (or float('-inf')). Revised (2026-09-23, V2.6 Phase 1): prompt now explicitly states the input is never empty (the fix's natural nums[0] initialization doesn't define empty-list behavior, so this closes a gap rather than opening one) and requests a fenced code block for the sandboxed grader; bug/difficulty unchanged.
